panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: Overdrive treats a local Claude Code setup as **one versioned tool**. It adds a loud terminal look and two Claude Code mods: a tab band above the prompt and colored, foldable tool rows.

items.title: VERSION
items.text: The overdrive CLI versions ~/.claude as a local git repo and pins every tool repo by SHA in one lock file.

items.title: MODS
items.text: overdrive-tabs draws a tab band above the prompt. overdrive-tools colors every tool row and folds it.

items.title: LOOK
items.text: An output style, a session banner and a five-row statusline share one neon palette and one art language.
`VERSION` holds the semver, `overdrive.lock` pins components by SHA, and every version keeps its own log.
A SessionStart hook checks the pins in under 150 ms and records drift in the background.
`INF` cyan for reads, `CHG` magenta for changes, `RUN` yellow for shell and agents. Click a tag to fold or open the row.
Code, tickets, Claude usage, overdrive state and a serpent pet, in a pink box above the prompt.
Every tool appends INFO, WARN and CRITICAL lines to one crash-safe log per Claude session.
`overdrive trace` reads a finished session: tool calls, wall time and token counts per tool.

rows.text: Copy to `~/.claude/output-styles/`, then select it under Output style in `/config`.
Point `statusLine.command` in `~/.claude/settings.json` at it. Chips for tools you lack stay empty.
A SessionStart hook: the pink banner and the frame reminder.
Link into your `PATH`. It expects `~/.claude` to be a local git repo.

panels.caption: The mod wraps the engine's own drawing. The stored row and the model's context do not change.

code:
git clone https://github.com/VelimirMueller/overdrive && cd overdrive
claude plugin marketplace add ./mods
claude plugin install overdrive-tools@overdrive-mods
claude plugin install overdrive-tabs@overdrive-mods

claude plugin validate mods/overdrive-tools
claude plugin test mods/overdrive-tools
claude plugin test mods/overdrive-tabs
python3 tools/overdrive/test_trace.py
